products.name: LlamaIndex
products.note: RAG framework; data connectors; indexing strategies; enterprise RAG governance

profile_text.body:
LlamaIndex is a software company that provides tooling for building AI-powered document and data workflows. Its primary offering is LlamaIndex, described by the company as a RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) framework with data connectors, indexing strategies, and enterprise RAG governance capabilities. The company also develops LlamaParse, which it describes as an agentic OCR product for processing complex documents containing tables, charts, and images, claiming human-level accuracy for parsing, extraction, indexing, and retrieval at enterprise scale. A separate open-source parsing library is offered for local use without cloud dependencies or LLM token consumption.

The company positions its products toward financial services, manufacturing, and healthcare use cases, citing banks, hedge funds, fintechs, manufacturers, and healthcare providers as the types of organizations adopting its tools. Applications the company highlights include financial due diligence, invoice processing, extraction from technical manuals and inspection reports, and handling of medical records and insurance claims. Schema-based extraction agents powered by large language models are offered without requiring model training by the end user.

The held facts confirm LlamaIndex maintains a tracked product profile on theworldofai.org under the coding and developer tools category. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
